title: Naruto From Zero: A Friendly Start
description: Ten easy questions on who made Naruto, where it ran and how big it got. No story knowledge needed.

questions.question: Who wrote and drew the Naruto manga?
questions.fun_fact: Masashi Kishimoto both wrote and drew the Naruto manga himself.

questions.question: In which magazine did the Naruto manga run?
questions.fun_fact: It ran in Weekly Shonen Jump, published by Shueisha.

questions.question: The Naruto manga was collected into how many volumes?
questions.fun_fact: The manga closed with 700 chapters gathered into 72 collected volumes.

questions.question: Which studio animated the Naruto TV anime?
questions.fun_fact: Studio Pierrot made Naruto and Naruto: Shippuden, directed by Hayato Date.

questions.question: How many episodes does the first TV series, simply called Naruto, have?
questions.fun_fact: The second series, Shippuden, adds 500 more, for 720 episodes in total.

questions.question: In which year did the Naruto manga start in Weekly Shonen Jump?
questions.fun_fact: It ran for about fifteen years, until mid November 2014.

questions.question: In which year did the first Naruto anime begin airing in Japan?
questions.fun_fact: Naruto, the first series, has 220 episodes and aired from 2002 to 2007.

questions.question: Of the first anime's 220 episodes, how many are original stories made only for TV?
questions.fun_fact: The first 135 episodes follow the manga, and the other 85 are stories made only for television.

questions.question: Which of these titles belongs to the Naruto franchise?
questions.fun_fact: The franchise includes Naruto, Naruto: Shippuden and the Boruto titles.

questions.question: The manga is split in two parts. Which volumes make up Part II?
questions.fun_fact: Volumes 1 to 27 follow Naruto as a child, and volumes 28 to 72 follow him as a teenager.

notes: Starter: every question cites an arc 0 fact only.
